title: Software factory
summary: Work comes in as work orders. Order turns each one into an item the factory can read. Triage decides whether the item is worth building. Plan writes down the approach. Build writes the change and opens a draft pull request. Three checks then read it (a review, a test check and a product check) and send what they find back to the builder, for up to three rounds. Once they approve, the factory reads CI and the reviews on the pull request and fixes what they raise. A change that is ready passes a gate, then waits for a person to land it. A person steps in only to answer the questions an item asks.

stages.label: Order
stages.blurb: Takes a work order and makes it one item the factory can read.

stages.label: Triage
stages.blurb: Reads a new item and decides whether it is worth building.

stages.label: Plan
stages.blurb: Works out how to build the item and writes the plan down.

stages.label: Build
stages.blurb: Writes the change and opens a draft pull request, then fixes what comes back.

stages.label: Checks
stages.blurb: A review, a test check and a product check read the change and approve it or send it back.

stages.label: CI and review
stages.blurb: Reads CI and the reviews on the pull request and sends back what they raise.

stages.label: Ready to land
stages.blurb: A gate checks the approved change, then it waits for a person to land it.
